title: it is said that … he is said to … he is supposed to …

exercises.instruction: Write each sentence in another way. Begin with the words in the description.

items.prompt: It is expected that the strike will end soon.
answers: The strike is expected to end soon.

items.prompt: It is reported that many people are homeless after the floods.
answers: Many people are reported to be homeless after the floods.

items.prompt: It is thought that the thieves got in through a window in the roof.
answers: The thieves are thought to have got in through a window in the roof.

items.prompt: It is alleged that the driver of the car was driving at 110 miles an hour.
answers: The driver (of the car) is alleged to have been driving at 110 miles an hour.
The driver (of the car) is alleged to have driven at 110 miles an hour.

items.prompt: It is reported that the building has been badly damaged by the fire.
answers: The building is reported to have been badly damaged by the fire.

items.prompt: It is said that the company is losing a lot of money.
answers: The company is said to be losing a lot of money.

items.prompt: It is believed that the company lost a lot of money last year.
answers: The company is believed to have lost a lot of money last year.

items.prompt: It is expected that the company will make a loss this year.
answers: The company is expected to make a loss this year.

exercises.instruction: Write sentences using supposed to be + one of these:

items.prompt: How is it that everybody knows about the plan?
answers: It's supposed to be a secret.

items.prompt: You shouldn't criticise me all the time.
answers: You're supposed to be my friend.
You are supposed to be my friend.

items.prompt: I shouldn't be eating this cake really.
answers: I'm supposed to be on a diet.
I am supposed to be on a diet.

items.prompt: I'm sorry for what I said. I was trying to be funny.
answers: It was supposed to be a joke.

items.prompt: What's this drawing? Is it a tree? Or maybe
answers: Or maybe it's supposed to be a flower.
Or maybe it is supposed to be a flower.

items.prompt: You shouldn't be playing a game now.
answers: You're supposed to be working.
You are supposed to be working.

items.prompt: That's strange. The museum seems to be closed.
answers: It's supposed to be open every day.

exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions and write sentences with supposed to … or not supposed to … . Choose from:

items.cue: 🅿️ You … your car here. It’s private parking only.
items.prompt: (park)
answers: You're not supposed to park your car here.
You are not supposed to park your car here.

items.cue: ⏰ We … work at 8.15, but we rarely do anything before 8.30.
items.prompt: (start)
answers: We're supposed to start work at 8.15, but we rarely do anything before 8.30.
We are supposed to start work at 8.15, but we rarely do anything before 8.30.

items.cue: 📞 I … Helen last night, but I completely forgot.
items.prompt: (phone)
answers: I was supposed to phone Helen last night, but I completely forgot.

items.cue: 🚪 This door is a fire exit. We … anything in front of it.
items.prompt: (put)
answers: This door is a fire exit. We aren't supposed to put anything in front of it.
